messages.content:
Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000606" [constraint]: The ledger service deploys on Wednesdays between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC.  (about: ledger service)
- memory_id "1000596" [constraint]: As of 2025-08-19, deploys to the job scheduler happen only on Tuesdays and Fridays between 09:00 and 10:30 UTC.  (about: job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000316" [constraint]: Per the change policy, the webhook dispatcher deploys on Mondays and Wednesdays between 14:00 and 16:00 UTC.  (about: webhook dispatcher)
- memory_id "1000335" [constraint]: Deploys to the bus happen on Thursdays between 07:00 and 09:00 UTC and at no other time.  (about: the bus)
- memory_id "1000217" [constraint]: The authentication gateway deploys on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC per the change policy.  (about: authentication gateway)
- memory_id "1000031": The ledger service is owned by the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000619" [constraint]: As of 2025-09-03, the catalog service (product catalog) deploys on weekdays between 08:00 and 10:00 UTC, never on Fridays.  (about: product catalog, catalog service)
- memory_id "1000283" [constraint]: The reporting service only ships on Tuesdays and Thursdays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC.  (about: reporting service)
- memory_id "1000228": On 2025-02-21, the Boreal team noticed the ledger service's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change and pinged the owners.  (about: Boreal team, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000417": INC-2025-011 affected the ledger service on 2025-05-24.  (about: ledger service, INC-2025-011)
- memory_id "1000160" [constraint]: The ledger service must stay on Postgres 14 until the partitioning work finishes.  (about: ledger service)
- memory_id "1000356": As of 2025-04-24, feature-flags' p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy.  (about: feature-flags)
- memory_id "1000198" [constraint]: The billing API only ships on weekdays after 15:00 UTC.  (about: billing API)
- memory_id "1000695": As of 2025-09-23, the reporting service no longer depends on the ledger service for the nightly balance export, having switched to the bus as its source.  (about: ledger service, the bus, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000521": On 2025-06-09, the Ember team handed the billing API to the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, billing API, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000250": The ledger service relies on the auth gateway for service tokens, so if the auth gateway is down, the ledger service is down.  (about: ledger service, auth gateway)
- memory_id "1000690": The nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs, which prompted the reporting service to switch from the ledger service to the bus.  (about: ledger service, billing API, the bus, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000516": As of 2025-06-09, the billing API lives with the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, billing API)
- memory_id "1000686" [decision]: As of 2025-09-23, the reporting service switched from the ledger service to the bus as its source.  (about: ledger service, the bus, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000538" [preference]: As of 2025-07-21, the Ember team runs its planning on Fridays.  (about: Ember team)
Existing entity names: ledger service, job scheduler, webhook dispatcher, the bus, authentication gateway, Atlas team, product catalog, catalog service, reporting service, Boreal team, INC-2025-011, feature-flags, billing API, Ember team, auth gateway
